relationship: Reward parallel: a crown for those who endure
rationale: Zechariah says the crown will be for those who endure, among the other native descriptions of its recipients and use. James calls the person enduring trial blessed and promises the approved person the crown of life. Both explicitly join endurance with receiving a crown. James' crown of life is not identified with the silver-and-gold crown of Zechariah's context, and it does not resolve Zephaniah's son or the other listed descriptions.

Zechariah promises the gathered prisoners settlement in a stronghold and double repayment in exchange for a day of sojourn. Job says that the Lord gave him double what he formerly possessed, after his prayer for his friends. Both state a divine doubling as a benefit following prior adversity. Job does not supply a one-day equivalence or a prison-to-stronghold setting, and the two recipients and measures of restoration remain distinct.

relationship: Community ethic: received benefit prevents boasting over others
rationale: Zechariah says the Lord saves Judah's dwellings so that David's house and Jerusalem will not exalt themselves over Judah. Paul likewise warns against being puffed up in favor of one against another and challenges boasting as if received gifts were not received. Both oppose one part of a community magnifying itself over another on the basis of what it has been given. Paul's community and its teachers are not identified with Judah, Jerusalem or David's house.

relationship: Lament imagery: lost pomegranate growth and communal grief
rationale: Zechariah compares Jerusalem's great mourning with mourning for a pomegranate grove cut down in a plain. Joel calls for mourning because the plains and crops have suffered, specifically includes dried-up pomegranate trees, and commands the ministers to lament. Both connect communal mourning with the loss of pomegranate growth in the land. Joel's drying is not equated with cutting down, and Zechariah's grove is not turned into an alternate place name or a named battle.
